title: Cascade: Hierarchical Recoverability Control for Large Language Model Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2609.16890v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning is essential for removing sensitive or copyrighted knowledge while preserving general utility. Existing methods often leave residual knowledge in intermediate representations, which can still be recovered. To address this, we propose Cascade, a hierarchical recoverability control framework that minimizes the internal identifiability of target knowledge. Cascade combines three complementary controls: path-level routing to suppress privacy-associated activation routes, representation-level compression to reduce geometric separability, and decoding-level intervention to limit residual recovery. Experiments on TOFU, MUSE-News, and WMDP, including robustness tests with query reformulation and extraction-style prompts, show that Cascade effectively reduces recoverability while maintaining stable model utility.

translated_title: Cascade：面向大语言模型遗忘的分层可恢复性控制
translated_abstract: 大语言模型遗忘对于移除敏感或受版权保护的知识、同时保持模型的通用能力至关重要。现有方法往往会在中间表示中留下残余知识，这些知识仍然可以被恢复。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Cascade，一个分层可恢复性控制框架，旨在最小化目标知识的内部可识别性。Cascade结合了三种互补的控制机制：路径级路由以抑制与隐私相关的激活路径，表示级压缩以降低几何可分离性，以及解码级干预以限制残余知识的恢复。在TOFU、MUSE-News和WMDP数据集上的实验（包括查询重构和提取式提示的鲁棒性测试）表明，Cascade在保持稳定模型效用的同时，有效降低了知识的可恢复性。
tldr: 提出了Cascade分层可恢复性控制框架，通过路径级路由、表示级压缩和解码级干预三种互补机制，有效抑制大语言模型遗忘后被删除知识的可恢复性，同时保持模型效用。
en_tdlr: Cascade is a hierarchical recoverability control framework that combines path-level routing, representation-level compression, and decoding-level intervention to effectively suppress the recoverability of unlearned knowledge in LLMs while maintaining model utility.
